environment.reference: installed Super Productivity 20.0.0 renderer, isolated temporary origin
environment.data: independent temporary DSH_HOME; no daily user data

additional_checks: edits during a held save request persist the final text
child creation remains enabled during autosave and waits for it
export download contains the latest saved note
completed rows retain timestamps and stay below active rows
900px board parent and child titles each occupy at most two 20px lines
light/dark color-scheme rendering and narrow detail overlay inspected
limitations: targeted UI regression, not full V-001 through V-030 release acceptance
no new SP planning, timer, tags, attachments or nested project folder data model
dark rendering was checked by emulating dark media and setting the document color scheme; host theme settings UI was not tested
